DIAGNOSIS READY: Testicular Torsion.

The patient is a 16-year-old male with sudden onset abdominal pain triggered by physical activity, which is the classic presentation of testicular torsion. Despite the reported "abdominal" pain, this condition often presents as lower abdominal or groin pain and is a surgical emergency requiring immediate evaluation of the scrotum and testicles. Please describe any associated scrotal swelling, redness, or nausea you may be experiencing.
